title: Group Policy (GPO)
subtitle: Active Directory-style centralized endpoint management: USB port storage locking, corporate wallpaper, inactivity screen lock, and OS restrictions.
empty_policies: No system policies defined yet. Click 'Create Policy' to configure endpoint GPO rules.
empty_states: No device policy states reported yet. Online devices sync when connected or triggered.
name_placeholder: e.g. Finance USB Lockout & Corporate Branding
description_placeholder: Provide context on when and why this GPO is enforced...
usb_intro: Disabling USB storage blocks USB flash drives and external disks exclusively.
usb_intro_strong: USB mice, keyboards, webcams, and printers use standard HID drivers and remain 100% active.
usb_allow_desc: Endpoints can read and write to USB flash drives normally.
usb_block_desc: Disables USB mass storage driver (`USBSTOR`) and disk drive policies. Flash drives cannot be mounted. Mouse and keyboard are completely unaffected.
usb_ro_desc: Users can view and read files on USB flash drives, but cannot write, copy, or exfiltrate data to the USB drive.
autoplay_desc: Prevents executables or scripts on plugged-in USB storage and optical media from automatically launching.
wallpaper_intro: Enforces corporate wallpaper across endpoints via Group Policy registry and instantly updates user desktops without requiring logoff or reboot.
wallpaper_enforce: Enforce corporate wallpaper on target machines
upload_hint: Supports PNG, JPG, BMP up to 10MB
wallpaper_url_label: Wallpaper Image URL or File Path *
wallpaper_url_hint: Uploaded image is distributed to all managed endpoints and applied to current desktops.
wallpaper_lock_desc: Prevents local users from modifying or replacing the desktop background via Windows Settings or right-click context menu.
security_intro: Enforce Windows Defender, firewall, PowerShell restrictions, and lock down sensitive management tools to prevent tampering.
firewall_desc: Forces firewall active across Domain, Private, and Public network profiles (`EnableFirewall = 1`).
defender_desc: Prevents local users from disabling Windows Defender real-time, behavior, and on-access protection.
powershell_desc: Sets PowerShell execution policy to `Restricted` to block script execution by unauthorized users.
taskmgr_desc: Prevents standard users from terminating security agents or processes.
cmd_desc: Blocks cmd.exe execution for standard users.
regedit_desc: Blocks regedit.exe to prevent tampering with local registry keys.
control_panel_desc: Prevents access to Windows Settings app and classic Control Panel.
admin_intro: Deploy a standardized local administrator account across all target endpoints. Resolves differing admin credentials and guarantees central IT support access during troubleshooting.
admin_enforce: Enforce Managed Local Administrator on Endpoints
admin_username_hint: Created/updated as local admin on target endpoints
admin_never_expires: Password Never Expires (Prevents account lockout on disconnected machines)
delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete policy "{name}"? Endpoints will revert to lower precedence policy or default settings.
admin_password_keep_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the stored password
admin_password_stored_hint: A password is stored. It is never shown; type a new one only to change it.
admin_password_required: Enter a password for the managed admin account.
